rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese choice for a dove, especially a small or white one.

example.english: After the wedding, everyone released a dove together.
example.traditional: 婚禮完咗，大家一齊放白鴿。
example.jyutping: fan1 lai5 jyun4 zo2 daai6 gaa1 jat1 cai4 fong3 baak6 gap3

rows.note: Use this broader word when the bird is being treated generally as a pigeon-like bird rather than specifically as a white dove.

example.english: I saw a dove looking for food by the rubbish bin.
example.traditional: 我見到隻鴿喺垃圾桶邊搵食。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gin3 dou2 zek3 gap3 hai2 laap6 saap3 tung2 bin1 wan2 sik6
